name: Swiftspeed App Builder for WooCommerce
author: swiftspeed

sections.description:
Swiftspeed turns your WooCommerce store into a real mobile app. Connect your store to Swiftspeed once and we build a Progressive Web App (PWA) you can ship at no cost, plus paid native iOS and Android builds whenever you are ready. No code, no API setup, no separate services. Everything stays in your WordPress dashboard.

Built for WooCommerce store owners who want a real mobile app without months of development work, app store wrangling, or maintaining a separate codebase.

Get a real mobile app for your WooCommerce store in 3 minutes

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Click Connect to Swiftspeed. We mint your WooCommerce REST API keys automatically and pair the store
  3. Pick a theme, set your colors, write your auth-screen copy
  4. Hit Sync and your products and categories are live in the app preview
  5. Share your PWA today, or subscribe to publish to the iOS App Store and Google Play

PWA at no cost

The Progressive Web App costs nothing. Customers visit a link, tap “Add to Home Screen,” and your store opens like a real app: full screen, splash screen, push notifications on Android. No code changes, no separate server, no app-store review. You get app installs without an Apple Developer account or a Google Play developer account.

PWA includes:

  • Native cart and checkout (uses your existing WooCommerce gateways)
  • Add to Home Screen on iOS, Android, desktop
  • Offline cache for product listings
  • Custom icon and splash screen
  • Your store colors and branding
  • Web push notifications (Android and desktop)

Native mobile app builds

When you are ready to ship a real app store presence:

  • Android APK for sideload and sharing
  • Android AAB for Google Play submission
  • iOS source bundle ready to open in Xcode and submit to App Store Connect
  • Bring your own keystore for stable Play Store updates
  • Auto-updates over the air. Design changes ship to installed apps without re-submission
  • Remove the “Powered by Swiftspeed” branding banner

AI-assisted setup

Do not want to pick colors and write auth copy yourself? Tell our AI builder what kind of store you run (“a wellness boutique”, “a hardware shop”) and it picks a theme, generates the homepage hero, writes button labels, and curates your category icons.

Full WooCommerce order management

Orders placed in the app land in WooCommerce > Orders as standard orders, marked paid, with line items, customer info, shipping address, and the gateway transaction ID. Fulfilment, refunds, emails, inventory: everything stays in WooCommerce as you already know it.

App customers automatically become WordPress users (with the customer role), so they can log into your store website with the same credentials, see their order history, and receive WooCommerce transactional emails.

Native cart and checkout

We do not wrap your shop page in a webview. Customers see a native catalog with smooth scroll, native add-to-cart, native quantity steppers, and a native checkout flow optimized for thumb-friendly mobile conversion. Your existing WooCommerce payment gateways are reused: Stripe, PayPal, Paystack, M-Pesa.

Push notifications (paid plans)

Send unlimited push notifications to your installed iOS, Android, and PWA users. Schedule, segment, target by behaviour, send abandoned-cart pings on a cron. Compose once, deliver to all platforms.

Plans

The PWA is free with no time limit. Native iOS and Android builds, branding removal, native push, and advanced features (AI builder, monetization, analytics, multi-language, e-wallet, bookings, in-app purchases) are available on paid plans. Current plan details and pricing are shown on swiftspeed.app when you connect. Cancel anytime.

Why pick Swiftspeed

  • 3-minute setup: install, activate, click Connect, done
  • Stays in your WP admin, no separate dashboards or extra tools to learn
  • PWA at no cost, start shipping a mobile app today, no card required
  • Real app store builds: APK, AAB, and iOS source you actually own
  • Bring your own keystore for stable Play Store releases
  • Standard WooCommerce flow: orders, customers, refunds, emails work the way you already know
  • AI-assisted: generate themes, layouts, and copy with one prompt
  • Cancel anytime with pro-rated billing

How orders flow

  1. Customer browses products in the app (cached locally for speed)
  2. Adds to cart, proceeds to native checkout
  3. Pays via your WooCommerce gateway (Stripe, PayPal, and so on)
  4. We create the order in WooCommerce as paid, with the wc_order_* payment transaction reference
  5. WooCommerce sends the standard order email, you fulfil from WP admin

How customer accounts flow

  1. Customer signs up in the app with email and password (or social login)
  2. We mirror them to WordPress as a customer user
  3. They can log in to your store website with the same credentials
  4. Order history syncs both ways

External services

This plugin connects to Swiftspeed (https://swiftspeed.app), the app-building service operated by Swiftspeed, to generate and publish your mobile app. The plugin cannot build a PWA or a native app on its own. The build pipeline, the app projects, your subscription, and support tickets all live on swiftspeed.app, and the plugin is the bridge between your WooCommerce store and that service.

The plugin contacts swiftspeed.app in the following cases:

  • When you click “Connect to Swiftspeed”. The plugin creates a WooCommerce REST API key pair (using WooCommerce’s own API-key system) and sends your store URL, store name, store description, the WooCommerce REST API consumer key and secret, and the plugin version to swiftspeed.app. Those keys let the service read your products, categories, and orders, and create orders and customer accounts through the WooCommerce REST API. The plugin does not create WordPress users and does not create WordPress Application Passwords. This happens only when you start the connect flow.
  • While you use the plugin admin screens after connecting. Saving design settings, app info, catalog and category curation, payment gateway configuration, queueing iOS or Android builds, reading build status and download links, managing your subscription, and opening or replying to support tickets each send the relevant data you entered (for example colors, theme choice, app name, gateway credentials you typed in, build type, ticket subject and message) along with an editor token that identifies your connected app. These requests happen only in response to your actions in the plugin admin.
  • When you open the live preview. The plugin can embed a preview of your app from swiftspeed.app. This preview does not load automatically; it is requested only after you click “Load live preview” inside the plugin. The Swiftspeed logo shown in the plugin header is bundled with the plugin and is not fetched from any external server.
  • When you disconnect or delete the plugin. The plugin removes the WooCommerce REST API key pair it created and tells swiftspeed.app it was removed. Your Swiftspeed account, WooCommerce data, and content remain on swiftspeed.app and in WooCommerce, and are managed there.

No data is sent to swiftspeed.app unless you install the plugin and start the connect flow. The plugin does not send data to any other third party.

Service provided by Swiftspeed:

  • Terms of Service: https://swiftspeed.app/terms-of-services
  • Privacy Policy: https://swiftspeed.app/privacy-policies
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via the Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active (the plugin requires WooCommerce 6.0 or newer)
  4. Go to WooCommerce to App in your admin menu
  5. Click Connect to Swiftspeed and follow the popup to sign in or sign up
  6. Customize design, payments, and catalog from the plugin tabs
sections.faq:
Do I need a Swiftspeed account?

Yes. Signup is free and takes about 60 seconds during the Connect flow. The plugin bridges to swiftspeed.app for the build pipeline. See the “External services” section above for what data is sent.

Does the PWA cost anything?

No. PWA generation, custom branding, push notifications (Android and desktop), and order sync have no time limit and no charge. No card required to use the free tier.

Do I need an Apple Developer account?

Only if you want to submit to the App Store. The iOS source we generate opens directly in Xcode and is ready to archive and submit. The PWA works on iOS without any developer account.

Where are orders processed?

Inside WooCommerce, exactly like web orders. Payments go through your existing WooCommerce gateways. Inventory deducts. Order emails send. We just provide the mobile UI.

Can I disconnect anytime?

Yes. The plugin’s Disconnect button cleans up the WooCommerce REST API keys it minted and clears local state. Your WooCommerce data is untouched.

Will it work if I deactivate the plugin?

Your existing app stays live on Swiftspeed and keeps serving the PWA and native app. Reactivate the plugin to manage it again. Disconnecting from inside the plugin is the cleanest way to remove the integration.

Does it work with my custom theme?

Yes. The mobile app pulls from the WooCommerce REST API (products, categories, prices, images, stock), so your theme is not involved. Whatever WooCommerce sees, the app sees.

What payment gateways are supported?

Stripe, PayPal, Paystack, and M-Pesa are wired in. The plugin’s Payments tab lets you configure each one with live or sandbox credentials.

Can I customize the in-app account screen?

Yes. The account screen is designed in the Swiftspeed editor (we link to it from the plugin). Avatar, fields, order-history layout, address book. It is auto-added when you connect.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • PWA generation with custom branding.
  • Native iOS and Android builds via a paid subscription.
  • Auto-create WooCommerce REST API keys on connect; no WordPress users or credentials are created.
  • Six themes, three layouts, custom color tokens.
  • Product and category curation (featured / hidden / pin to home / custom icons).
  • Stripe, PayPal, Paystack, and M-Pesa payment gateway support.
  • Order list and customer account auto-creation.
  • Sync interval configurable from 5 minutes to daily.
  • AI-assisted setup (theme and copy generation).
  • Pro-rated upgrades and cancellations via Stripe Billing.
